description: Election Commission - N. Sachchithanandam was Selected as the Member of the Vavuniya U/C, J. M. T. R. Thilakarathna was Selected as the Member of the Tirappane Pradeshiya Sabha,. P. Indram was Selected as the Member of the Veugalacheddikulam Pradeshiya Sabha.
